summary: Frontend-only testing of ALT&ACT static React site (HashRouter). Validated the new 5-group data-driven navigation (desktop + mobile), the Coopérer dropdown alignment, the new homepage Coopérations and Témoignages sections, the /#/cooperations page, the repositioned RE'ACTIF PRO presentation page (ecosystem framing + 7-step frise + admin flow with password Choukette@777), the realigned footer, and regression on main routes. All P1/P2 checks pass with no console errors or warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation dropdowns are correctly data-driven from src/data/menu.js with proper data-testid attributes on triggers and links (desktop + mobile prefixed variants).
Coopérer dropdown is correctly right-aligned and does not overflow (right edge ~1443 < viewport 1920 at desktop).
Footer no longer contains any /notre-vision link (regression requirement met).
test_credentials: Admin RE'ACTIF PRO password: Choukette@777 (client-side localStorage toggle) — verified working, admin-toggle-panel displays after submit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P1 features from iteration 4 request are validated: 5 nav groups (qui-sommes-nous, agir-avec-vous, nos-actions, nos-projets, cooperer) with all expected link testids visible on hover; desktop navigation clicks lead to correct hash URLs; /#/cooperations page shows 5 fiches (recherche, emploi, entreprises, associations, collectivites) + maniere-agir-section + temoignages-section + proposer-section with 3 CTAs; homepage shows cooperations-section (3 fiches with 3 rubriques each) + temoignages-section (4 témoignages + mention) + cooperations-voir-tout button navigates to /#/cooperations; /#/reactif-pro/presentation shows reactif-hero-intro (ecosystem phrase present), reactif-ecosysteme-badge, reactif-intro (title + 'n'est pas ALT&ACT' phrase), reactif-maniere-agir with 7-step frise (etape-observer→etape-reajuster), admin-access-btn + password Choukette@777 reveals admin-toggle-panel; footer has 'Qui sommes-nous ?' and 'Agir & coopérer' columns, no /notre-vision link, Nos coopérations footer link navigates to /#/cooperations; regression routes /#/, /#/agir-avec-vous, /#/prevenir-les-ruptures, /#/membres, /#/contact, /#/vision-methode load without console errors; mobile 390x844 toggle opens menu, mobile-* link testids present, clicking mobile-cooperations-link navigates and visually closes the menu (screenshot confirms icon returns to hamburger). Zero console errors/warnings across accueil, /#/cooperations, /#/reactif-pro/presentation.
